result.title: Integrating Learned Priors through Prior-Space Reparameterization for Physically Based Inverse Rendering
result.summary: Physically based inverse rendering decomposes appearance into materials and illumination, an ambiguous problem for which learned material predictions provide useful prior information. Most existing methods incorporate these cues through auxiliary regularization losses, which alter the optimization objective and require balancing their influence against photometric fitting. We propose a prior-guided material reparameterization that uses the predicted feature relationships to restrict the optimization space while leaving the objective unchanged. We fuse multi-view material predictions onto a mesh and construct a permutohedral lattice in the resulting prior feature space. Surface points with similar predictions share material variables, which are optimized jointly with geometry and illumination using a purely photometric objective. Experiments with two learned predictors on three synthetic benchmarks and Stanford-ORB demonstrate improved material decomposition and relighting. Our method improves relighting PSNR by 1.5-2.5 dB over the strongest evaluated mesh-based baseline on Synthetic4Relight and TensoIR-Synthetic, and outperforms a regularization loss using the same prior in controlled comparisons. We further show that our reparameterization pools noisy photometric gradients, producing updates that are more consistent across sampled views. This consistency enables a shortened joint optimization schedule that takes less than a minute while retaining relighting quality above all evaluated baselines on TensoIR-Synthetic.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究基于物理的逆向渲染中如何注入学习到的材质先验：将多视角材质预测融合到网格上，在预测特征空间构建 permutohedral lattice，使预测相似的表面点共享材质变量，并在保持纯光度目标不变的前提下与几何、光照联合优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用先验特征空间重参数化限制优化空间，并借变量共享汇聚多视角噪声梯度」的思路，可能为 LVR 中先验约束 latent 状态空间、相似状态合并及训练信号分配提供可供核查的类比，但领域相距较远，迁移需较多改造。
